why: A preprints.org paper titled 'There Are Infinitely Many Sophie Germain Primes' (Oct 2025) and an Integers 25 (2025) note by Agoh claim proofs, but search summaries conflict on what Agoh actually proved (possibly that non-Sophie-Germain primes are infinite, a different statement) and neither claim appears to have mainstream acceptance; could not confirm from summaries alone whether either genuinely resolves the stated conjecture.
